messages:
Jordan (CS): Hi team — customer AcmeCorp reported ~14 users lost access to paid features after a SCIM sync overnight. They say users still appear in Okta, but inside the app roles are gone. Can someone look?
Alex W: ack. Is this the same tenant that had the nested-group migration last month?
Jordan (CS): Yes, likely. Their Okta -> SCIM mapper was changed recently to include nested groups. They pointed to this log snippet from our provisioning webhook: 
```
2026-03-10T03:12:17Z WARN scim-sync: group-mapping: skip assigning role for user u-12345 -> group "/Engineering/Tools" external_id mismatch (got: \'/Engineering/Tools\', expected: \'Engineering/Tools\')
2026-03-10T03:12:17Z ERROR scim-sync: role-assign failed: role not found for mapped-group id=null
```
Priya - Eng: hmm external_id mismatch + leading slash sounds like normalization problem in the mapper. Our mapping config expects exact externalId == role.external_id (no leading slashes).
Samira - IAM: also looks like when the mapper switched to include nested groups, it started emitting group.externalId for nested members with a leading "/". That would break equality checks that assume exact string match.
Jordan (CS): Customer says most affected users were added to nested groups via SAML SSO (not direct Okta group). They saw deprovisions happening (roles removed) during the full re-sync at 03:12.
Alex W: Can we reproduce quickly? What's the repro payload?
Priya - Eng: repro steps I used locally: 1) create group A (/Engineering) with externalId "Engineering"; 2) create nested group B under A with externalId "/Engineering/Tools"; 3) add user memberOf B; 4) run our scim /sync job. The sync path in our code does exact match: role = roleIndex[ group.externalId ] -> if null, we call unassignRole(user, role) mistakenly leading to removal.
Samira - IAM: initial mitigation: add a temporary tolerant check that strips leading slashes before comparing. We can flip a feature-flag for the mapper in prod.
Jordan (CS): Customer is impacted now. They want immediate fix + backfill of removed roles for current users.
Alex W: Plan: (A) Pause SCIM daily full sync for AcmeCorp (so we don't flip more users) (B) run a backfill script to reassign roles for affected users (C) a short-term mapper patch to normalize externalIds (D) schedule proper migration and add tests.
Samira - IAM: I'll pause the schedule for the tenant now. calling provisioning-bot...
provisioning-bot: @Samira - IAM: Paused scheduled sync for tenant acmecorp (tenant_id: t-789) at 2026-03-10T03:31:05Z :white_check_mark:
Samira - IAM: I'm kicking off a targeted audit to list users with removed paid roles between 03:00-04:00 UTC. Using internal admin endpoint: `GET /admin/tenants/t-789/audit?event=role_unassign&from=2026-03-10T03:00Z&to=2026-03-10T04:00Z`
Priya - Eng: I pushed a hotfix branch `fix/scim-strip-externalid` that normalizes group.externalId before lookup. Patch includes unit tests and a feature-flag gate. Diff snippet: 
```diff
- mappedId = group.externalId
+ mappedId = group.externalId?.replace(/^\/+/, '')
```
Alex W: Nice. How long to deploy behind flag?
Priya - Eng: Can do staged deploy to dedicated infra in 15-20m, enable only for acmecorp. Backfill script next.
Jordan (CS): Backfill approach?
Samira - IAM: We'll reconstruct desired role state from Okta membership API for the tenant: fetch all groups for each user and map to internal roles using normalization rule, then call admin role-assign for mismatched users. Script outline: 
1) GET /okta/api/v1/users?filter=... (tenant users)
2) for each user GET /okta/api/v1/user/{id}/groups
3) normalize group.externalId (strip leading slash, trim)
4) map to role id via roleIndex and call POST /admin/roles/assign { user_id, role_id }
Include a dry-run mode to print changes.
Jordan (CS): Customer wants audit log of what we change and ability to rollback. Make sure we include who/when in the request metadata.
Priya - Eng: backfill script implemented in the branch `scripts/scim-backfill`. Dry run output looks good for 14 users. Sample output: 
```
DRY-RUN: user u-12345 -> will assign role r-paid-tools (was null)
DRY-RUN: user u-23456 -> will assign role r-paid-tools (was null)
```
Alex W: Who will own the deploy & backfill?
Samira - IAM: I'll run the backfill after Priya deploys the mapper fix behind flag. I'll also create audit entries per assignment with `source: scim-backfill-2026-03-10` and retain them.
Jordan (CS): Customer asked if this is a data-loss issue (i.e., were roles permanently deleted).
Priya - Eng: No deletions were permanent. Our system removes role assignment entries but audit logs show original assignments. We can re-create exactly.
Samira - IAM: Running backfill now (non-dry-run) at 2026-03-10T03:45Z. pausing to monitor.
provisioning-bot: Backfill started for tenant t-789, total_candidates=14
Samira - IAM: Completed backfill run. 14/14 assignments re-created. Audit ids: [a-8801, a-8802, a-8803 ...] (full list in pastebin)
Jordan (CS): Shared the remediation notes to the customer. They want change to mapper config in Okta too so nested group externalIds don't include leading slash.
Priya - Eng: I'll follow up with a permanent mapper migration: normalize on write, add unit/integration tests for nested group shapes, and add a reconciliation job that does tolerant-match for legacy externalIds for the next 30 days.
Alex W: Anything else?
Jordan (CS): Customer asked for an incident postmortem and timeline. Can someone own?
Samira - IAM: I'll own the postmortem. Tentative items: cause (mapper normalization mismatch after nested-groups change), impact (14 users lost paid access briefly), mitigation (paused sync, backfilled, hotfix behind flag), long-term fix (mapper migration + tolerant reconciliation + deploy-time tests).
Jordan (CS): Thanks all. I'll follow up with customer with ETA for permanent migration and attach audit paste. :thumbsup:
Alex W: Good catch. :rocket:
